info.name: Hatsune Miku Nightcord at 25:00
info.description: A custom Hatsune Miku theme inspired by Nightcord at 25:00 from Project SEKAI. Features soft blue, lavender and white colors with a dreamy atmosphere, clean typography, and a calm night aesthetic. Perfect for Miku and Nightcord fans.
